plan.gate_contract: per test, separately declared one-sided pass/failure error budgets across fixed looks 5,9,17,33; no whole-suite multiplicity adjustment
plan.mean_runtime_estimand: geometric mean of paired complete-runtime ratios
plan.interval_scope: 95% pointwise Clopper-Pearson intervals over independent simulated test replications, not simultaneous across factors/outcomes
assumptions: stationary paired lognormal outer runtimes for the parametric generator
the empirical generator is conditional on a finite measured jitter sample; its uncertainty is not a future hardware bound
block resampling preserves short serial dependence and therefore stress-tests, rather than proves, the independent-time assumption
model applicability and hardware health are separate; simulated direct-full timing has no abbreviation model error
plan.qualification_scope: decision logic simulation only; no receiver speed, mixed-CI-dispatch, or future error-rate qualification
